reason: The problem is real: my son got out and the police found him two streets away, so I would love something that tells me where he is. But I have never heard of TODO, and I am not putting a camera on my child and paying a monthly fee to a company I do not know when it really matters. I need to see that it works on a bad day, not just in a nice ad.
objection: Will the live video, voice and GPS actually connect when my child is far away and in trouble, and will the SOS alert reach me? A new brand's promise means nothing to me until other parents like me have used it in a real emergency.
would_change_my_mind: Honest reviews from other parents of wandering children showing the GPS and SOS working in a real incident, plus a trial period with a full refund if the device does not do what it says.
